title: Turkey Burgers
ingredients: Whole grain wraps or burger buns as appropriate
instructions: Mix turkey, egg, psyllium husk, soy sauce, and spices.
Form into 2 wide patties.
Air fry at 190°C for 11–13 minutes, flipping halfway.
Serve with wraps/buns and salad toppings.

title: Homemade Lasagna
instructions: Cook onion and garlic in olive oil until soft.
Brown meat, add tomato paste, tomatoes, herbs, salt, pepper; simmer 25 min.
Make béchamel: melt butter, whisk in flour, gradually add milk, season.
Layer sauce, noodles, béchamel, meat, and cheese. Repeat.
Bake 180°C for 35-40 min. Rest 10 min. Garnish with basil.

title: Keto Cheesecake
instructions: Preheat oven 177°C. Mix crust ingredients, press into pan, bake 10-12 min.
Beat cream cheese with sweetener, add eggs one at a time, then lemon & vanilla.
Pour filling on crust, bake 40-55 min until center jiggly. Chill 4+ hours.

title: Gluten Free Keto Bread with Yeast
instructions: Proof yeast in warm water and sweetener 7 min.
Mix dry ingredients in separate bowl.
Add eggs, butter, vinegar to yeast, then combine with dry ingredients and sour cream.
Transfer to loaf pan, let rise 50-60 min.
Bake 180°C for 45-55 min until golden. Cool completely.

title: Fluffy Keto Buns
instructions: Preheat oven 180°C. Mix all ingredients until smooth.
Let dough rest 2 min. Divide into 4 buns, place on baking tray.
Sprinkle seeds, score tops, bake 25 min until golden.

title: Keto Bread Rolls
instructions: Preheat oven 180°C. Melt cheeses together.
Mix with almond flour and 2 eggs to form dough.
Shape into 10 balls, brush with remaining egg.
Bake 25 min until golden.

title: Creamy Chicken and Broccoli Pasta
instructions: Season chicken and sauté until just cooked, set aside.
Cook onion and garlic until translucent.
Add pasta, 2 cups broth, spices; simmer 8 min until almost cooked.
Add broccoli, remaining broth; simmer 4 min.
Add chicken, milk, cheese, lemon; simmer 5 min. Let sit 2-3 min.

title: Bread and Butter Pudding
instructions: Preheat oven 170°C. Layer bread and raisins in greased dish.
Beat milk, eggs, sugar, vanilla; pour over bread.
Press bread down to soak, sprinkle cinnamon.
Bake 35-45 min until set.

title: Basic Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven 175°C. Mix dry ingredients in bowl.
Whisk milk, butter, eggs; combine with dry ingredients.
Divide into muffin tins, bake 20-25 min until toothpick clean.

title: Sandwich Bread
instructions: Mix water, milk, yeast, sugar; rest 5 min.
Add butter, salt, flour gradually; knead 3 min.
First rise 1-2 hours until doubled.
Shape loaf, second rise 1 hour.
Bake 177°C for 32 min until golden. Cool before slicing.
